To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the synthetic formation of the α,α‐substituted labionin building block is achieved by an efficient stereoselective synthesis starting from a protected 2‐methylalanine derivative.
the first synthetic building block for the future assembly and synthesis of the type III lantipeptides labyrinthopeptin has been developed.
a new class of antibiotics has been isolated, and the key step in their synthesis has been achieved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the total synthesis of the type III lantipeptides labyrinthopeptin and planosporicin.

the synthesis of a new class of polycyclic peptides, namely the labyrinthopeptins, which are produced by the actinomycete Actinoplanes licheniformis ATCC 39727 and which contain a unique structural feature, the α,α‐substituted amino acid labionin.
the total synthesis of the new lantibiotics labyrinthopeptin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the synthesis of the α,α‐di‐methylated amino acids is a difficult problem.
the synthetic studies reported here have been successful and have provided the basis to proceed toward the total synthesis of labyrinthopeptins.

we have developed a new synthetic strategy for the formation of α,α‐substituted amino acids by a stereoselective and convergent route starting from an enantioenriched α‐amino ester and a suitable aldehyde.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a novel synthetic strategy for the formation of α‐amino acids containing two identical quartenary α,α′‐substituted amino acid side‐chains.

we have been able to prepare the first orthogonally Fmoc-protected α,α-disubstituted aminoacid derivative in a convergent fashion and that we have been also able to prepare a first orthogonall protected labionin building block.
the synthesis of the α,α‐substituted amino acid is the key step for the future total synthesis of labyrinthopeptins and that the synthetic approach is feasible.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to prepare the α,α‐substituted labionin amino acid precursor in an enantiomerically pure form by using a simple chiral pool approach, starting from the inexpensive natural amino acid phenylalanine.
the use of a chiral auxiliary in the form of an oxazolidinone is a very powerful tool for the synthesis of quaternary α‐substituted amino acids.
the synthesis of the α,α‐substituted amino acid precursor of Lab can be achieved in a highly stereoselective manner.
